components.purpose: The detailed grid below the plans: a title and subtitle plus a plan-by-feature matrix with features grouped into sections (Features, Analysis, Support) and yes/no, number, or text values for every plan. This is the component the instance guidance names for comparing many features across plans. PricingCards is not added because the plans are already above; ComparisonTable is not used because it is for editor-managed rows, not pricing plans.
